steps.name: Given the PayPal sandbox API base URL is configured
Given the performance safety limits are loaded
Given a valid PayPal access token has been obtained
Given an order request for 1 "T-Shirt" item priced at "100.00" "USD" with intent "AUTHORIZE"
Given a burst of 3 simultaneous order requests sharing one PayPal-Request-Id
When I release the burst against the create order endpoint
When I resend the order request with the same PayPal-Request-Id after the burst
Then the requests in the burst should have been released within 250 milliseconds of each other
Then no request in the burst should have been rate limited
Then exactly one order should have been created by the burst
